analysis.title: Fresenius Medical Care (FMEG.DE): Q3 26 slightly ahead on EBIT; narrowed FY26 guidance implies sharp deceleration in EBIT growth in Q4
key_insights: Q3 26 group revenue was €4,937m, +0.8% above Vara consensus. Constant currency growth was -0.5% as Care Delivery (+1.1%) and Care Enablement (+5.1%) were offset by Value-Based Care (-8.6%).

Adjusted EBIT was €545m, 5.2% above Vara consensus of €518m and 3.9% above GSe of €524m. The adjusted EBIT margin was 11.0%, down 80bps Y/Y. The beat came from Care Delivery, where margin expanded despite TDAPA headwinds.
US same-market treatment growth (SMTG) deteriorated to -1.1% in Q3 26, but the result was better than some investors had expected.

FY26 guidance was narrowed. Constant currency revenue growth is still expected to be flat (vs Vara consensus +1.3%). Adjusted EBIT growth is now guided to between flat and negative mid-single-digit (previously +/- mid-single-digit).
On GS math, the midpoint of the updated EBIT guidance implies a decline of about 30% in adjusted EBIT growth in the final quarter, a sharp deceleration.

Care Delivery revenue grew +1% in constant currency to €3,492m (GSe +2.3%), with portfolio divestitures a 40bp headwind. Adjusted EBIT rose +2% in constant currency to €513m and the margin expanded 20bp Y/Y to 14.7%.

In the US, Care Delivery revenue grew +1% in constant currency as favorable rate effects were offset by the expected TDAPA headwind. International revenue grew 3% in constant currency, with organic growth of 6% and same-market treatment growth of 1.4%.

Care Enablement revenue rose +5% in constant currency, in line with GS expectations, on positive global pricing and volume growth outside China, mainly 5008X CAREsystem sales. Adjusted EBIT rose +4% in constant currency to €106m, but margin fell 30bp Y/Y to 7.3%, below GSe of 8.4%.

Value-Based Care revenue fell -8.6% in constant currency to €537m (GSe -15.0%). The decline was mainly due to a change in risk contracting for one contract, partly offset by higher payor premium rates and prior-year phasing of CKCC reporting from CMS. Adjusted EBIT was €1m, with margin up 380bp Y/Y to 0.1%.
GS rates FMEG Neutral with a 12-month price target of EUR 38, 6.2% below the EUR 40.50 close on 2 Nov 2026. Based on GS estimates the stock trades on 9.8x NTM P/E.

market_movers.rationale: Q3 EBIT beat on Care Delivery, but narrowed FY26 guidance implies a sharp Q4 EBIT decline and US volumes remain negative. The price target is below the current price of EUR 40.50.

earnings_insights: Q3 26 reported 11/3: group revenue €4,937m vs GSe €4,955m and Vara consensus €4,899m (+0.8% vs consensus). Constant currency growth -0.5% vs GSe -0.1% and consensus -0.6%.
Q3 26 reported 11/3: adjusted EBIT €545m vs GSe €524m and Vara consensus €518m (+5.2% vs consensus). Adjusted EBIT margin 11.0% vs GSe 10.6% and consensus 10.6%.
Q3 26 reported 11/3: basic adjusted EPS €1.11 vs GSe €1.05 and Vara consensus €1.03 (+7.4% vs consensus). Net financials were -€81m vs consensus -€84m, and income tax was -€78m vs consensus -€70m.
Care Delivery Q3 26 reported: revenue €3,492m vs Vara consensus €3,467m, EBIT €513m vs consensus €482m (+6.4%), margin 14.7% vs consensus 13.9%.
Care Enablement Q3 26 reported: revenue €1,451m vs Vara consensus €1,412m, but EBIT €106m was 5.4% below consensus €112m and margin 7.3% was below consensus 7.9%.
Value-Based Care Q3 26 reported: revenue €537m vs Vara consensus €516m, EBIT €1m vs consensus €2m.
FY26 guidance (company): constant currency revenue growth flat vs Vara consensus +1.3%. Adjusted EBIT growth between flat and negative MSD, narrowed from +/- MSD.
GS forecasts (estimates, not reported): FY26E revenue €20,028.6m, EBIT €2,113.0m, EPS €4.21. FY27E EBIT €2,097.7m, EPS €4.11. Quarterly EPS estimates are Q2 26E €1.13, Q3 26E €1.05 and Q4 26E €1.12.
risk_factors: Downside risks to the view and PT: US dialysis volume growth not rebounding, low reimbursement for Medicare PPS dialysis, GLP-1s potentially reducing the ESRD patient population over time, Hv-HDF not being as successful as expected, and a stake sale.

Upside risks to the view and PT: US dialysis volume growth improving ahead of expectations, benefits of Hv-HDF coming through faster than anticipated, favorable policy decisions, and margin headwinds abating.

tension_points.bull_case: Q3 adjusted EBIT of €545m beat consensus by 5.2%, driven by Care Delivery margin expansion despite TDAPA headwinds. US SMTG of -1.1% was better than some investors expected.
tension_points.bear_case: Narrowed guidance of flat to negative MSD adjusted EBIT growth implies roughly a 30% decline in the final quarter on GS math. Revenue guidance of flat is below Vara consensus of +1.3%.
tension_points.what_invalidates: US dialysis volume growth not rebounding from -1.1% same-market treatment growth would undermine the bull case. A rebound ahead of expectations would challenge the bear case.

theme_stances.key_argument: The updated guidance midpoint implies a sharp decline in adjusted EBIT growth in the final quarter, despite the Q3 beat.
theme_stances.evidence: updated guidance points to a sharp decline in adjusted EBIT growth
